caption: The drawing depicts a clear glass jar with a lid. The jar has a wide, rounded body that tapers slightly toward the opening, and a flared rim. The lid fits snugly on the top and features a knob for gripping, whose shape is rounded and smooth. Both the jar and lid are rendered in translucent shades of gray and light blue, indicating the reflective and transparent qualities of glass. To the right of the jar, there is a detailed circular rendering of the seal on the bottom of the jar, showing the text “FRS. J. McFEE PITTSBURGH PA” in raised letters. The drawing has a light beige background with visible signs of aging, such as faint brownish stains and minor discoloration near the edges. The artist's signature, "J. Mitry," appears near the bottom right of the jar.
title: Preserving Jar
